question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Calculate bowling average per bowler
WITH wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id 
        AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
batting_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extra_runs_agg AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND er.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id 
        AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    w.bowler,
    w.wickets,
    br.runs,
    er.extras,
    br.runs + er.extras as total_runs_conceded,
    ROUND(1.0 * (br.runs + er.extras) / w.wickets, 2) as bowling_average
FROM wickets w
JOIN batting_runs br ON w.bowler = br.bowler
JOIN extra_runs_agg er ON w.bowler = er.bowler
WHERE w.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20
